purpose: Distinguish factory exit from whole-force proximity after the formed candidate regressed against urban Supalosa; fixed original economics and observation protocol

decision.budget: 48 starts, inspect all outcomes once; no candidate changes during this batch
decision.mechanism: The new gate waits for four tanks outside vehicle-factory footprints. It does not require tanks already fighting to return to a six-tile group or avoid every other building rectangle.
decision.diagnosis: On the first urban candidate replay, check that destroying a local target is followed by continued progress rather than a return to the opening rally; preserve any counterexample
decision.next: A useful candidate must be compared afresh with M0 across the same full development pool before any player update. Keep the reserved mp08t2 map unplayed until a candidate has resolved the observed regression.
